annotation.title_clean: Communication from the Commission to the Council and the European Parliament on countering potential threats posed by drones
annotation.title_en: Communication from the Commission to the Council and the European Parliament on countering potential threats posed by drones
annotation.summary_en: European Commission Communication setting out the EU counter-drone policy against non-cooperative civil drones. It outlines six activity strands: community building, testing and standardisation of counter-drone systems, practical guidance, research and innovation, funding, and exploring regulatory measures. It finds no harmonised EU counter-drone regulation exists and commissions a mapping study.
key_provisions_or_claims: Sets up a counter-drone expert group and explores a digital platform for sharing drone incident information.
Develops a harmonised testing methodology and voluntary performance requirements for counter-drone systems, with certification as a mid-term objective.
Launches a mapping study on regulatory needs and an aviation security risk assessment that may mandate regulatory changes.
Funds counter-drone work via ISF, Horizon Europe and the EDF, and creates a JRC living lab and centre of excellence.
Covers the period to 2030, with mid-term stocktaking in 2027.
